$Comment: Percent bonus to the healing the carrier gives, on themselves and on others, in whole percent points (20 heals a fifth more). Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers. Every heal a mod pays through ziggfreed-common's HealthUtil.heal with a healer takes it; regeneration and a drain such as lifesteal do not. Base 0; Min -100, so a subtractive modifier can at most stop a heal.
